items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: An action, or a link that looks like one: variants, sizes, an icon, a loading state.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: A short status or count next to text: default, secondary, outline, destructive.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: A text field with a focus ring, a disabled state and an invalid state.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: A multi-line field for a message or a note.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: The visible name of a field, tied to its control.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: A label, a control, help and the error, wired together with aria-describedby and aria-invalid.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: On or off for one option, with a label you can click and a disabled state.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: An on/off setting that applies at once.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: A panel with a header, content and a footer, for settings, summaries and plans.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: A hairline between groups, horizontal or vertical.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: A message on the page: a title, a line and an icon, neutral or destructive.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: A keyboard key or a shortcut of several keys.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: A face, with initials when the photo is missing; in a row as a group.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: Panels behind a row of tabs, arrow keys between them.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: A modal that keeps focus inside, closes on Escape and returns focus to its trigger.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown menu
items.description: A menu behind a button: items with icons and shortcuts, checkbox items and groups.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: The native select, styled: groups, a placeholder and disabled options, no JavaScript.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: A short label on hover and keyboard focus.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Short confirmations that appear and leave on their own, with an action to undo.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio group
items.description: One choice from a few, with hints under each option; arrow keys choose.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: Page links with Previous and Next, the current page marked and gaps where pages are skipped.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Where the page sits: the levels as links, separators, a collapsed middle and the current page.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: A placeholder in the shape of the content while it loads.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Rows and columns with a caption, a header and a footer, right-aligned numbers.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: Sections that open one at a time or together, with the keyboard model and a height animation.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: How far along a task is, as a bar with its value read out.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: A value or a range on a track, with arrow keys and the value shown.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: A panel next to its trigger for a short form or details; Escape and outside clicks close it.

items.name: command-menu
items.title: Command menu
items.description: A command palette: type to filter, arrows and Enter, grouped commands and shortcuts.

items.name: search-field
items.title: Search field
items.description: A search input in a role=search form, with a / shortcut and a clear button.

items.name: sidebar-nav
items.title: Sidebar navigation
items.description: A docs sidebar: groups of links, the current page marked, groups that fold open and shut.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: A side sheet for filters, a cart or details: slides in from its edge, focus stays inside.

items.name: link-list
items.title: Link list
items.description: Links as rows with a title, a line and a chevron; the whole row is the target.

items.name: empty-state
items.title: Empty state
items.description: Nothing here yet, or no results: an icon, what is going on and what to do next.

items.name: tag
items.title: Tag
items.description: A topic or an active filter: static, a link, or removable with focus moving to the next tag.

items.name: filter-bar
items.title: Filter bar
items.description: Toggle chips, a sort choice and a live result count; Clear turns every filter off.

items.name: filter-sheet
items.title: Filter sheet
items.description: The phone Filters button: active count, checkbox groups in a side sheet, Clear all and Show results.

items.name: steps
items.title: Steps
items.description: Progress through a flow: done, current (aria-current=step) and to come; horizontal when there is room.

items.name: quantity
items.title: Quantity
items.description: Minus, a number field and plus as one control; the buttons turn off at the ends.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code block
items.description: Code with a filename bar and a Copy button, in a focusable scroll box.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: A swipeable row with Previous and Next that turn off at the ends, keyboard included. No autoplay.

items.name: date-field
items.title: Date field
items.description: The native date input in the field style, or a from–to range whose end can never fall before its start.

items.name: toolbar
items.title: Toolbar
items.description: A row of controls that is one Tab stop; arrows move. Toggle buttons, and a "Was this helpful?" row.

items.name: copy-button
items.title: Copy button
items.description: Copies a value, an element's text or a file from your site, then says Copied for a moment, announced to screen readers.

items.name: read-aloud
items.title: Read aloud
items.description: Listen to an article: the browser's own speech reads it, with pause, resume and stop. Nothing leaves the page.

items.name: language-switcher
items.title: Language switcher
items.description: The page's other languages as links with lang and hreflang behind one button; the current one is marked.

items.name: toc
items.title: On this page
items.description: A page's sections as links; the one you are reading is marked while you scroll.

items.name: link
items.title: Link
items.description: Inline in text, standalone with an arrow, or external with an arrow out and a new-tab note for screen readers.

items.name: icon
items.title: Icons
items.description: Lucide, the icon set shadcn/ui draws with: a stroke, a size, a label when they stand alone.

items.name: bar-chart
items.title: Bar chart
items.description: A server-rendered column chart with values on top and the same data as a table for screen readers. No chart library.

items.name: video-player
items.title: Video player
items.description: A poster with one Play button; native controls and captions once it plays. Nothing plays by itself.

items.name: map-embed
items.title: Map
items.description: A location whose map loads from OpenStreetMap only when asked; the address works as a link without it.

items.name: story-card
items.title: Story card
items.description: Picture, kicker, the title as the one link, a line and the meta; standard, compact, wide and feature.

items.name: section-header
items.title: Section header
items.description: The head of a page section: a kicker, the heading, a line or two and an optional action, on the type scale.

items.name: segmented
items.title: Segmented control
items.description: A single-choice toggle group drawn as one track, like a monthly/yearly switch.

items.name: result-list
items.title: Search results
items.description: An announced count, then ranked results with the address and the match marked in each snippet.

items.name: announcement
items.title: Announcement bar
items.description: A one-line site notice with a read-more link and a close button that can stay closed for the session.

items.name: hero
items.title: Hero
items.description: Journey-planner hero: from/to card with leave-at tabs, a day-out photo card and four quick-task tiles.

items.name: pricing
items.title: Pricing
items.description: Three plan cards under a monthly/yearly switch, the middle one framed with a tab, beside a photo card for schools.

items.name: faq
items.title: FAQ
items.description: Bold questions in hairline rows that open as native details, beside a heading and a front-desk card with phone.

items.name: site-header
items.title: Site header
items.description: A muted service strip over a 72px bar: wordmark, six centred links, a pill search and saved and bag counts.

items.name: site-footer
items.title: Site footer
items.description: Brand and a call-us card, five dense link columns, then trust marks, legal links and an age notice.

items.name: newsletter
items.title: Newsletter signup
items.description: A grocery's weekly offers letter in one tinted band: a produce photo, the pitch, an inline email field and three facts.

items.name: contact-form
items.title: Contact form
items.description: A developer tool's contact card: pitch, reply times and a customer quote beside a labelled form with topic chips.

items.name: logo-strip
items.title: Logo strip
items.description: One centred line over seven client wordmarks set in type, in one grey row, with a case-study link.

items.name: login-form
items.title: Login form
items.description: An energy supplier's sign-in card with a show/hide password, secondary ways in and a side strip of other routes.

items.name: breadcrumb-trail

items.description: A home icon and chevron levels on one line above a category title; on a phone the middle folds, the last truncates.

items.name: card-carousel

items.description: A garden store's weekly offers: a photo lead card, then product cards with deal badges and prices that scroll sideways.

items.name: comparison-table
items.title: Comparison table
items.description: An honest strong/weak box over a three-way table: your column shaded with its call to action, ticks, real figures.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data table
items.description: A tariff table in a pale panel: grouped rows, bold items with units, price changes and a worked example in the footer.

items.name: header-bar

items.name: icon-sidebar

items.name: lift-card

items.name: link-card
items.title: Link cards

items.name: modal

items.name: numbered-pagination

items.name: plain-tiles

items.name: search-bar

items.name: split-card

items.name: feature-grid

items.name: stats-row

items.name: testimonial

items.name: social-links-02
items.title: Icon follow row
items.description: A footer row of follow links in each brand's own black or white mark at full strength, optically equal in size, with 44px round targets whose fill (never the mark) changes on hover and a "Follow us on …" name each.

items.name: button-03
items.title: Download with size
items.description: A download link dressed as a button, with the file type and size muted after the label and in its accessible name.

items.name: badge-03
items.title: Category tag
items.description: A topic tag tinted with one of the theme's five chart colours, picked from a hash of the category name so each topic keeps its colour; it can link to the category.

items.name: badge-12
items.title: Status pill
items.description: A dot and a word for the state of a job, subscription or service, in light success, warning, error or neutral tints that read the same without colour.

items.name: avatar-05
items.title: Member list rows
items.description: Member rows with avatar, name, email and a trailing role button; invited people get initials, an "Invited" badge and a Remove action instead.

items.name: avatar-10
items.title: Stack with overflow list
items.description: Overlapping portraits that end in a counted "+n" button; one click lists everyone, with roles, in a popover.

items.name: bento-03
items.title: Checklist tile
items.description: A title, one line and five checked items; title left and list right in a wide cell.

items.name: bento-09
items.title: Icon feature tile
items.description: The plain workhorse: an icon in a muted square, a title, two lines and an optional small link.

items.name: feature-card-02
items.title: Checklist card
items.description: A title, one short line and four points, each with a filled check, under a hairline.

items.name: feature-card-05
items.title: Icon card
items.description: A lucide icon in a small muted square, a title and two lines of text, with an optional link whose arrow nudges on hover.

items.name: article-card-02
items.title: Compact article
items.description: Just the title with the date and reading time under it, a text-only card that is one link, for dense lists and sidebars.

items.name: article-card-10
items.title: Standard article
items.description: A 3:2 photo, a category badge, the title, a three-line excerpt and a byline with the date under a hairline; the whole card is one link.

items.name: person-card-03
items.title: Portrait card
items.description: A tall 3:4 portrait in a quiet bordered card with name, role, brand-correct social icon links and a "View profile" link; the photo warms to full colour on hover or focus.

items.name: testimonial-card-03
items.title: Quote card
items.description: A bordered card with the quote in 18px and the avatar, name and role under it; the avatar falls back to initials.

items.name: stat-tile-05
items.title: Icon stat
items.description: A lucide icon in a muted rounded square, the figure, its label and one short note.

items.name: stat-tile-06
items.title: KPI with delta
items.description: A label, one figure and the change on the previous period, said with an arrow, the word up or down and the number.

items.name: price-10
items.title: Plan price
items.description: A plan's amount with the period it pays for and one billing note, the sign and cents set small beside the whole number.

items.name: price-11
items.title: Sale price
items.description: The new price large, the old one struck through beside it and the saving said in words, with Was and Now for screen readers.

items.name: rating-03
items.title: Compact inline rating
items.description: One star, the number and the review count on one line for cards, with the whole phrase for screen readers.

items.name: rating-08
items.title: Star display
items.description: Stars in half steps with the number and an optional review count, read out as one phrase by screen readers.

items.name: code-03
items.title: Install command
items.description: One install command in npm, pnpm, yarn and bun tabs, each with its own copy button and a copied state; every panel is in the server HTML.

items.name: input-group-02
items.title: Prefix and suffix
items.description: A text field with fixed text on both sides, such as https:// and .com, set off in tinted add-ons.

items.name: input-group-03
items.title: Clearable
items.description: A field whose round clear button appears once it has content; Escape clears it too and focus stays in the field.

items.name: password-03
items.title: Reveal toggle
items.description: A plain password field with a show/hide button that keeps your place and a warning when Caps Lock is on.

items.name: otp-input-04
items.title: Six-box code
items.description: A one-time code drawn as six separate boxes over one real input, so SMS autofill, paste and Backspace just work.

items.name: phone-input-02
items.title: Phone with country code
items.description: A phone field with a joined native country code select (NL +31) that groups the number the way each country writes it as you type.

items.name: address-input-04
items.title: Address fields
items.description: The full address form done properly: a country select that switches to that country's own field order and labels, native autocomplete tokens and an error per field.

items.name: amount-input-01
items.title: Currency field
items.description: A money field with the symbol joined to it that tidies the number when you leave it (1234,5 becomes 1,234.50) and shows and enforces its min and max.

items.name: date-picker-02
items.title: Date of birth
items.description: Day, month and year fields with no calendar, checked for dates that don't exist, future years and a minimum age, with one error line.

items.name: date-picker-04
items.title: Deadline field
items.description: A date field with a calendar panel and a hint that counts from today, from "3 days left" to "Due today" and "2 days overdue", in calendar or working days.

items.name: file-upload-05
items.title: Dropzone
items.description: A large dashed drop area that doubles as the browse button, with accepted types, a size limit, a dragging state and the chosen files listed under it.

items.name: choice-card-07
items.title: Stacked radio list
items.description: One bordered list of radio options, each with a visible radio, a title and a description line.

items.name: choice-card-12
items.title: Yes-no cards
items.description: Two large cards side by side for one binary question, each with a short answer and one line on what it means.

items.name: range-slider-04
items.title: Value bubble
items.description: A slider whose value rides in a small bubble above the thumb, following it and kept inside the ends of the track.

items.name: multi-select-05
items.title: Tag input
items.description: Type a tag and press Enter or a comma to add it as a chip inside the field, Backspace to take the last one off; duplicates are refused and there is a maximum.

items.name: form-message-03
items.title: Inline error with fix
items.description: A field error that says what is wrong and, under it, how to fix it, set off by a red rule between the label and the field.

items.name: consent-02
items.title: Cookie bar
items.description: A bordered cookie bar with a short text and policy link, where Accept all, Reject all and Settings carry exactly the same weight.

items.name: notice-01
items.title: Callout
items.description: Note, tip and caution callouts for docs, with a left accent, a lead-in label and room for prose, links and code.

items.name: notice-05
items.title: Inline info
items.description: One quiet line of information inside a form or page, with an icon and a word for its tone.

items.name: toast-05
items.title: Stacked toasts
items.description: Toasts that pile up offset behind each other and fan out into a list on hover or focus, each one dismissible.

items.name: notification-item-04
items.title: Inbox row
items.description: One notification in an inbox: icon, text, relative time, an unread dot and mark-read and archive actions, with undo after archiving.

items.name: progress-08
items.title: Usage meter
items.description: Usage against a plan limit with the count and percentage, warning near the limit and turning red over it.

items.name: status-indicator-06
items.title: Service status
items.description: The state of a service in a light tinted panel with an icon, a word, when it was last checked and a link to the status page.

items.name: toc-03
items.title: Scrollspy toc
items.description: An On this page list of anchor links that marks the section being read, with optional indented h3 items.
